meta.title: TLRP · Multi-Mode Matrix Engine
meta.description: Registers the tlrp settings namespace, an editable matrix of runtime modes, /mode and per-mode alias commands, live {{tlrp_character}} / {{tlrp_directive}} / {{now}} prompt variables, a per-turn tail status block, and physical tool gating driven by each mode's toolPolicy.
